decision_2_differentia_contributes_conte.derivation: Goddard (2012) Table 1, 'Semantic primes (English exponents), grouped into related categories' (data/external/references/goddard-2012-primes-molecules-templates.txt, sha256 42ecd360..., local data, not in git): the categories 'substantives', 'relational substantives' and 'life and death' whole, plus the table exponents with a TIME, PLACE or WORDS allolex (WHEN~TIME, WHERE~PLACE, WORDS). questions_for_rohan: The roots carry their identity and nothing else (as decided); all 42 anchors already held it, so decision 3 added no cells, and 12.9M open cells now sit under open genera (act, state, person, change.v.01, quality, ...). Should anything settle a root's or a main genus word's other banks, and from which source? Nothing in the sources does now.

A Wiktionary genus word ('a person who ...') reads as the union of all its senses. Should a genus word that names an anchor (person, act, state, time, place) read as its anchored synset instead? That would be a sense choice; no rule makes it now.
WORDS is an identity bank because the decision names it; Goddard 2012 files it under speech. I and YOU are identity banks because the substantives category holds them. Keep or strike either?
The adjective parser takes the numeral 'two' as genus ('Such that any two elements ...'): 513 cells, all from the fully determined prime 'two'. Should a quantifier or numeral prime ever be a genus?

Catalog axioms are fully determined like every prime: die is ALIVE- with HAPPEN 0, be-somewhere is BE+ with WHERE 0, place is WHERE+ with 0 elsewhere. Are these zeros right for the units, or should a catalog axiom state only its own bank (as a root axiom does)?
little-few, more, much-many, some and some-time have no catalog sign (QUANTITY without a sign, or no bank). Which bank and sign, if any?
Closed-class axioms zero every undeclared bank, so 'nowhere' is WHERE 0. Should the curated entries declare their place/time banks?

Two sample cells inherit a stored value that WordNet's filing makes wrong (shuffle THINK+ via reordering.n.01; finale CAUSE+ via the act of finishing). The closure never changes a stored value; the stored ones are the release's to review.
